_about: Moving-link and bench rows, attempt 5. The a3 reviewer's rows (cad/review/a3/review_rows.json), adapted to the attempt-5 stops (four M3 screws ride on the link, their heads act on the block), and the a4 reviewer's step-14 rows (cad/review/a4/review_rows.json) adapted to the bench re-snug. Run on check_moving.blend, which to_cadcheck.py writes with each cartridge split into PRT_cartfix_* (fixed) and PRT_movlink_* (moving), and the right cartridge group copied into the stop-setting cradle 250 mm outboard: cad check cad/blender/check_moving.blend cad/blender/checks_moving.json OUT --only slide,distances,sightlines

slide_out.name: a3R R moving link (with the four stop screws and nuts it carries) push -y: first contact is the push heads' top faces on the block
a3R R moving link pull +y: first contact is the pull heads' undersides on the block's front counterbores

a3R R moving link down -z (lean / bag), adapted a7: the leaves carry it axially (never reached); the first rigid stop is the piston on the cartridge's catch saddle at catch_c (a6: the barrel lip at lip_c). The catch is part of the fixed body, so the fixed body is in this row now; its 0.3 check-split gap at the leaf feet is larger than catch_c. a8: the saddle touches on an R1.2 crown (a line), and a slide calls a stop only at 0.5 mm3 of overlap, which a line contact reaches about 0.1 past touch: the window runs to catch_c + 0.12 (the distances row reads the gap itself, catch_c)

a3R R moving link up +z (lift), adapted a8: the leaves carry it axially (16 kN/mm, never reached). As a pure translation the first rigid stop is the top link on its cavity roof in the fin at cav (a8: lip_c 1.2 is now bigger than cav); a real lift turns the link about the cell, and then the piston lands on the barrel lip first (stacks row 'a8 lift'). The fixed body is ignored because the check split leaves a 0.3 gap at the leaf feet

a3R R moving link sideways outboard: a sideways shift (only possible if the clamped cell slips) is caught first (a7) by the catch saddle round the piston (catch_c radial; 0.25-0.3 sideways where the saddle wraps the piston's lower half), else by the stop screws in their 0.5-radial block holes and counterbores; the link is 1.0 clear of the fin and the piston 0.7 from the lip (adapted: a4 had the fin at 0.8-1.3)

a3R R moving link sideways inboard: a sideways shift (only possible if the clamped cell slips) is caught first (a7) by the catch saddle round the piston (catch_c radial; 0.25-0.3 sideways where the saddle wraps the piston's lower half), else by the stop screws in their 0.5-radial block holes and counterbores; the link is 1.0 clear of the fin and the piston 0.7 from the lip (adapted: a4 had the fin at 0.8-1.3)
a3R R a2-row adapted: cartridge fixed body (block, ground bar, front nut and washer) pulled +y is held by the fin lips behind the block within 0.15
a3R R a2-row adapted: cartridge fixed body pushed -y is held by the fin's front wall within 0.15
